sloka: ततः संरक्तनयनः क्रुद्धो वैवस्वतः प्रभुः ।कालदण्डममोघं तु तोलयामास पाणिना ।। ७.२२.३३ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ saṁraktanayanaḥ kruddho vaivasvataḥ prabhuḥ ।kāladaṇḍamamoghaṁ tu tolayāmāsa pāṇinā ।। 7.22.33 ॥

translations.english: Having heard his words, the powerful Dharmaraja then said to Death, "You wait, I will kill this one."
